items.name: astro
items.notes: Node >=22.12.0 (npm engines). Ships no JS by default. Source: registry.npmjs.org/astro

items.name: swup
items.notes: 8216 B gz for dist/Swup.module.js (jsDelivr). Core only; plugins extra.

items.name: @swup/astro
items.maintenance: Last publish 2026-02-14, before Astro 7 (2026-06-22); no peerDependencies declared
items.notes: Astro 7 compatibility not verified. Depends on swup ^4 and many @swup/* plugins (npm registry JSON). Fallback: use swup plus plugins directly.

items.name: gsap
items.runtimeNetwork: None (grep for sendBeacon/XMLHttpRequest: 0 hits in gsap.min.js)
items.notes: Plugins gz: ScrollTrigger 18.0, SplitText 3.6, CustomEase 3.7, all included in npm package and covered by licence (effective 2025-04-30). Prohibited use: visual animation builders like Webflow. No attribution or telemetry clause.

items.name: animejs
items.notes: import { animate, spring } from 'animejs'; esbuild tree-shake animate+spring 14.1 kB gz, +stagger+createTimeline 16.8; full anime.esm.min.js 41.0. Subpath exports ./timer ./animation ./timeline ./animatable ./draggable ./scope ./engine etc. spring params bounce, duration, mass, stiffness, damping, velocity (animejs.com/documentation/easings/spring).

items.name: lenis
items.notes: 5418 B gz for dist/lenis.min.js. Optional peers: vue, react, @nuxt/kit.

items.name: three
items.notes: esbuild --minify tree-shake of WebGLRenderer from build/three.module.js: 132 kB gz (527,601 B raw); with Scene, camera, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, ShaderMaterial and others 133 kB. Full prebuilt three.module.min 90.2 + three.core.min 104.8 = about 195 kB gz. Budget about 135 kB gz.

items.name: @paper-design/shaders
items.notes: Size is an esm.sh estimate: ShaderMount + one shader about 40 kB gz; full bundle 64.5 kB. 37 shader modules (mesh-gradient, grain-gradient, liquid-metal, paper-texture, god-rays, water, etc.). sideEffects false, zero deps; pin exact version.

items.name: troika-three-text
items.runtimeNetwork: Default unicodeFontsURL = cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lojjic/unicode-font-resolver for fallback glyphs (found in esm file)
items.notes: Self-host fonts and set unicodeFontsURL. Deps: bidi-js, troika-three-utils, troika-worker-utils, webgl-sdf-generator. Peer three >=0.125.

items.name: postprocessing
items.notes: Estimate (esm.sh, three external): EffectComposer+RenderPass+BloomEffect+EffectPass about 16 kB gz; full build/index.js 157.6 kB gz measured. Peer three >=0.168 <0.187 blocks r187.

items.name: detect-gpu
items.maintenance: Stale: no release in about 19 months
items.notes: Self-host the benchmarks directory and pass benchmarksURL, or skip the lib and gate on renderer string and frame-time.

items.name: ogl
items.notes: esm.sh estimate for Renderer+Program+Mesh+Triangle 14.4 kB gz.

items.name: stegu/webgl-noise
items.notes: Copyright Ashima Arts (2011) for simplex noise, Stefan Gustavson (2011-2016) for the rest. Keep the notice in the shader source.

items.name: Fraunces
items.notes: VF wght 100-900 plus opsz; full file adds SOFT/WONK. Latin woff2: wght 36,620 B; wght italic 45,656; opsz 67,304; full 121,016 (jsDelivr sizes).

items.name: Instrument Serif
items.notes: Static 400 plus italic; Latin woff2 21,032 B (italic 22,128).

items.name: Gloock
items.notes: Static 400; Latin woff2 26,356 B.

items.name: Newsreader
items.notes: VF wght 200-800 plus opsz. Latin woff2: wght 58,084 B (italic 64,520); opsz 132,000.

items.name: Source Serif 4
items.notes: VF wght 200-900 plus opsz. Latin woff2: wght 50,824 B; opsz 122,360.

items.name: Bricolage Grotesque
items.notes: VF wght 200-800; opsz and wdth variants exist. Latin woff2 wght 41,344 B.

items.name: Hanken Grotesk
items.notes: VF wght 100-900. Latin woff2 34,704 B (italic 35,592).

items.name: Inter Tight
items.notes: VF wght 100-900. Latin woff2 44,872 B.

items.name: JetBrains Mono
items.notes: VF wght 100-800. Latin woff2 40,404 B (italic 42,964).

items.name: Geist Mono
items.notes: VF wght 100-900. Latin woff2 23,128 B (italic 25,516).

items.name: IBM Plex Mono
items.notes: Static only; Latin woff2 400 14,708 B, 700 14,908 B, italics about 16.5 kB each.

items.name: Ronzino (Collletttivo)
items.notes: Static, 6 styles, Latin only (Basic and Extended Latin); designers Luigi Gorlero and Nunzio Mazzaferro. Latin file size not measured.

items.name: Le Murmure (Velvetyne)
items.notes: Single static style; Latin, Greek, Cyrillic; download supplies source files (format not stated); woff2 conversion needed.

items.name: Terminal Grotesque (Velvetyne)
items.notes: Regular and Open styles; Latin only; variable not stated.

items.name: Gambetta / Zodiak / Boska / Sentient / Erode (Fontshare)
items.licence: ITF Free Font License v2.0 (17 Aug 2026), closed-source freeware
items.runtimeNetwork: None when self-hosted; Fontshare API optional
items.notes: Serif families; each reports 2 variable styles via api.fontshare.com/v2/fonts (license_type itf_ffl). Self-hosting via @font-face permitted (Sec. 01). Subsetting, format conversion and Derivative Works forbidden without written consent (Sec. 02, 05). Boska is listed as Serif, Display.

items.name: Switzer / General Sans / Satoshi (Fontshare)
items.licence: ITF Free Font License v2.0 (17 Aug 2026)
items.notes: Sans families, 2 variable styles each. Same restrictions: no subsetting, no format conversion, no derivative fonts.

items.name: @gltf-transform/cli
items.notes: Node >=20. Depends on sharp, meshoptimizer, draco3dgltf, ktx-parse, gltf-validator.

items.name: sharp
items.notes: Node >=20.9.0. Prebuilt @img/sharp-* binaries include libvips (LGPL-3.0), config libvips >=8.18.7. Build-time only.

items.name: @axe-core/playwright
items.notes: Depends on axe-core ~4.13.0; peer playwright-core >=1.0.0. MPL-2.0 file-level copyleft; dev tool only.

items.name: lighthouse
items.notes: Node >=22.19 (npm engines).

items.name: @lhci/cli
items.runtimeNetwork: Optional upload to LHCI server; disable
items.notes: Bundles lighthouse ^12.6.1, not 13. Scores diverge from Lighthouse 13.5. Run lighthouse 13 directly.

items.name: size-limit
items.notes: Node ^22.19.0 || ^24.5.0 || >=26. Requires an @size-limit/* preset.

items.name: glyphhanger
items.notes: Depends on jsdom, connect, shelljs, characterset and @zachleat/spider-pig; calls pyftsubset (fonttools). Use fonttools directly.

items.name: fonttools (pyftsubset)
items.notes: Python >=3.11 (PyPI). woff2 output needs brotli 1.2.0 (MIT). Only for OFL fonts; never for Fontshare ITF FFL fonts.

corrections.claim: @paper-design/shaders has "37 shader modules in dist/shaders/ (jsDelivr listing)"; the same claim is repeated in the items[] notes.
corrections.correction: The jsDelivr flat listing for 0.0.81 shows 30 .js shader modules in dist/shaders/ (and 30 .d.ts). The pack's own enumerated list also has 30 names. 37 is wrong. Downstream agents should say 30.

corrections.claim: Maintenance signal: "10 of 13 published within 6 months. detect-gpu, ogl and @swup/astro (Feb 2026) are the stale ones."
corrections.correction: Only 9 of the 13 have an npm publish date within 6 months of 2026-10-02: astro, swup, gsap (2026-04-13), animejs, lenis, three, paper shaders, troika, postprocessing. The 10th is stegu/webgl-noise, which is not on npm and has no date, so it cannot count. Minor, but the arithmetic is wrong.
corrections.source: registry.npmjs.org time fields for each package

corrections.claim: Font rows' date column (e.g. Fraunces 2025-09-10, Geist Mono 2026-06-08), under the intro "All versions and dates come from the npm registry".
corrections.correction: Those dates are the Google Fonts lastModified values from api.fontsource.org. The actual npm publish date of @fontsource/fraunces 5.3.0 and @fontsource-variable/fraunces 5.3.0 is 2026-07-19. The version 5.3.0 and the font sizes are correct, but the dates are not npm dates. Fontsource's lastModified is a different thing.

unsupported: @paper-design/shaders ~40 kB (ShaderMount plus one shader) and full 64.5 kB, postprocessing ~16 kB, and ogl 14.4 kB are esm.sh estimates. The pack discloses this, and I did not reproduce them. Treat them as unverified. No evidence files back them (the scout folder holds only e1-e4, three, anime and ogl-index).

The "0 fetch/XMLHttpRequest/sendBeacon hits" grep claims for gsap, lenis and shader-mount were not re-run. The pack says it is a string check only. The troika and detect-gpu CDN URLs were confirmed by grep.
GitHub LICENSE URLs in items[].licenceUrl were not fetched, as the pack itself admits. The licence names do match the npm metadata.
IBM Plex Mono is described as "static 400/700 plus italics", but Fontsource lists weights 100-700. The claim is true for the shortlisted cuts but implies there is no thinner weight.

The GSAP "Plain English Summary" on the licence page says use is free "as long as end users are not charged a fee of any kind" and points to a Business Club licence otherwise. The pack omits this caveat. The formal clauses do not repeat it, but agents should know it exists. A free portfolio is fine.
Red-flag text about Fontshare section numbers (01, 02, 05) was not individually mapped. The prohibition wording itself is confirmed.
